# PR #249 round 2 — performance PASS WITH NOTES

Head: cbe6a01d2bd9ad72f8b3e3c0fb839967804d8959
Request: 01a1f198-b767-7e20-8f91-b0616a244a38
Reviewer: pij-vast-silkworm, performance/249
Delta reviewed from0c7649929f8b4837f4d0d131a151077d8d223b79 in the requested worktree. Unrelated rebased F208 extension/docs changes are excluded. No local build/test, code edit or daemon bounce.

## Decision

R249-001 is closed. pa_presence.rs:1046 now records NotFound with stale=true. CachedSize::fresh therefore returns false at the next eligible round, even for an idle seat with no further activity. The adapter can then find a transcript whose earlier synthetic miss expired. Unbound and Unsupported remain completed and do not acquire a perpetual retry. No remaining blocking finding in this final-round delta.

## Incremental cost

- Existing PA scheduler: one round per60s. The large-seat path builds one union of eligible primed-scope fleet seats, deduplicated by SeatId (placed set, pa_presence.rs:727-749). Each permanently NotFound seat is scheduled for at most one PA status attempt per round; pending slow reads already remain bounded by the existing read_blocks mechanism.
- Copilot: at most one missing-path loader stat per minute from this PA path,0 walks. A miss younger than30s (possibly installed by another request) answers without a lookup.
- Claude/OMP/Codex: at most one whole-root miss walk per minute per stable missing seat from the PA path, not one every30s from this caller. Across other requesters the adapter still limits stable misses to one completed lookup/30s. A walk is still proportional to the root tree and can be costly; the final delta adds no nested per-PA multiplier here.
- There is no blanket reread of known idle fleets. The new retry population is NotFound entries, including permanently missing idle seats in an eligible primed scope. No new timer, process launch, wire field, map or retained allocation. The new cost is O(M) status attempts per60s for M such missing seats, replacing the incorrect permanent unknown.
- NotFound supplies no size and cannot manufacture a large-seat crossing. Existing presence claims still own once-per-crossing delivery; when a real large size becomes visible, the normal claim sends once.
- with_miss_ttl is public compiled code, not #[cfg(test)]; #[must_use] is not an access guard. Current callsite search finds only the new daemon regression outside its definition. Production constructors still choose MISS_TTL=30s, with no production-config route to the test duration. No performance blocker.
